title: Sensory evidence decoding during decisions
scientific_question: On the exposed within-session Steinmetz panel, how accurately do first100ms neural observations identify the prespecified three-way stimulus-contrast class, and what predictive information remains beyond causal history and observed wheel motion?
primary_outputs: Per-trial class derived from recorded left/right stimulus contrasts under an exact three-class mapping. The current manifest names the three-way target but does not supply that mapping; it must be recovered rather than guessed.

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.
This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

inputs: Manifest-declared first100ms spike events plus permitted causal context; exact event units, clock conversion and three-class mapping require recovered packet source.
Four paired views: context; neural plus context; wheel plus context; neural plus wheel plus context. Each view must share rows, split and permitted common fields.
forbidden_inputs: Current left/right stimulus contrasts or target-derived features in query context
Final choices, responses after the permitted observation cutoff and target-derived trial lengths

primary.name: equal-mouse natural-log loss for the three-way presented-contrast target
primary.aggregation: Mean over required query trials per session, then equal sessions within each mouse and equal mice; exact recovered scorer must confirm this hierarchy.
primary.rationale: A proper probability score distinguishes calibrated discrimination from majority accuracy; absolute error remains visible even if an incremental comparator is weak.

secondary: Prespecified paired wheel/context loss minus neural/wheel/context loss, with all four absolute-arm losses; positive means incremental predictive information.
Sum-of-three multiclass Brier score and top1 accuracy.
Retain the historical ln(3) minus joint-loss diagnostic separately; it does not establish neural information beyond context.

comparators.name: uniform three-class probability
comparators.procedure: Fixed probabilities1/3; log loss ln(3). This analytic reference is declared in the historical interface.

comparators.name: matched causal context and wheel/context predictors
comparators.inputs: Identical permitted causal history, clock and wheel observations without neural events
comparators.procedure: Proposed current four-arm competent control: freeze one selection procedure, training-only fitting and comparable search budgets across arms before query access; uniform alone is insufficient.

evaluation.uncertainty: Current declaration specifies paired bootstrap over10 mice with10000 PCG64 draws, seed20261102, linear2.5/97.5 percentiles. This is a declared analysis, not an executed interval; within-session dependencies and exposed-development interpretation remain.
evaluation.failure_policy: All39 sessions and all2042 queries in every arm are required before private grading. Missing/duplicate/malformed cases fail the complete comparison. Valid zero true-class probability yields infinite log loss, not clipping or dropped cases.
